title: A UAP class attacks with microwave weapons and shuts down systems

tellings.quote: And there is another class, which actually attacked us microwave weapons. That is, they actually turned off ours systems. Translated everything

plain: A man named James Valor, from Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call up UFOs, says one type of unidentified craft his team met in the early 2020s attacked them. He says these craft used microwave weapons and turned off the team's systems. He tells it as a witness, and if true it would mean that some of these objects are hostile and can disable equipment.
